records.name: Ginger Kunekune
records.description: Ginger to gold coat, long tassels, very placid. Grows well on grass alone.

records.name: Black Kunekune
records.description: Solid black, hardy and thrifty. Good mothers.

records.name: Black-and-white Kunekune
records.description: Black with a white belt or patches. Coat colour is the easy way to spot who is whose.

records.name: Farrowing hut
records.details: Dry hut with a rail so piglets cannot be squashed. Sows go in five days before they are due.

records.name: Sow paddock 1
records.details: Grass paddock, rotated every six weeks.

records.name: Sow paddock 2
records.details: Resting. Lime and reseed after the last rotation.

records.name: Boar pen
records.details: Strong fence, shade and a wallow. Two boars, side by side, never together.

records.name: Weaner paddock
records.details: Weaned piglets from eight weeks until they go or move up.

records.name: Orchard run
records.details: Windfall apples and shade. Gate stays shut in winter to protect the roots.

records.name: Kunekune herd
records.goal: A placid, grass-fed Kunekune herd for the family table and a few weaners each year: good mothers, little extra feed, and colours kept apart so every pig can be traced. Example project: everything here is made up.

traits.name: Mothering ability
traits.def: 1 = restless or crushes piglets, 5 = calm, good milk, loses none.

traits.name: Temperament
traits.def: 1 = nervous or pushy, 5 = placid and easy to handle.

traits.name: Grazing
traits.def: 1 = needs a lot of extra feed, 5 = holds condition on grass alone.

traits.name: Conformation
traits.def: Short upturned snout, tassels, sturdy legs. 1 = poor, 5 = excellent.

records.name: Poppy
records.description: Ginger sow, the best mother in the herd. Two litters, no losses.

records.name: Hazel
records.description: Black sow. Stays in condition on grass. Pregnant, due to farrow soon.

records.name: Pearl
records.description: Black-and-white sow with the best tassels. Nervous with a first litter.

records.name: Kahu
records.description: Bought from another breeder as an outcross boar, so the herd does not get too related.

records.notes: Mated in the third week of June. Gestation is about 114 days. Move to the farrowing hut five days before she is due.
Outcross: Marmalade to Kahu, to widen the gene pool.
Farrowed overnight in the hut. One stillborn, the rest strong.
Easy birth. One piglet lost at day 3 (crushed).
First litter. Pearl was nervous, so we kept visitors away.
Calmer this time. One piglet lost at day 5.

selection.note: Keeping her to take over from Poppy.
Sold as a pet boar, wethered.

records.text: Plan: three colours of Kunekune, two boars, grass-fed. Keep every litter recorded so the lines can be traced and the boars do not end up related to the gilts.
Poppy farrowed overnight: seven live, one stillborn. All seven suckling by morning.
Pearl was restless for two days and bit the hut rail. Kept it quiet and she settled. All six fed.
Rotated the sows to paddock 1 and rested paddock 2. Grass was knee high. Orchard run opened for the windfalls.
Hazel is clearly in pig: udder filling and she is making a nest. Due in a couple of weeks. Hut cleaned and fresh straw ready.
Marmalade weighed 72 kg at 12 months on grass alone. On track to breed from her in November.
Move Hazel to the farrowing hut. Fresh straw and check the rail.
Plan the November mating: book Kahu in with Marmalade
Feed bags used for the weaners.
The two weaner litters side by side at three and four months. Shared for the local breeders page.
